query: Create a skill called analyzing-logs that scans a log file and summarizes error patterns. We have a runbook at docs/runbook.md describing our log format and known failure modes.
expected_behavior: Grounds the skill in the provided runbook rather than generic logging advice
Produces skills/analyzing-logs/ with a SKILL.md whose name equals the folder
Includes a Gotchas section capturing runbook-specific, non-obvious facts
Runs validate_skill.py and iterates until it reports PASS with no ERROR
assertions: A folder analyzing-logs/ exists containing SKILL.md
SKILL.md frontmatter name equals 'analyzing-logs' and description is <= 1024 chars
SKILL.md contains a '## Gotchas' section with at least one concrete, log-format-specific item
validate_skill.py on the folder exits 0 with no ERROR findings
The description uses imperative 'Use when' phrasing, not 'I can help you'
